text.ledger.parameter.action.description: Filter by type of performed action.
text.ledger.parameter.after.description: Filter by time (after the provided time).
text.ledger.parameter.before.description: Filter by time (before the provided time). Usually you want to use after.
text.ledger.parameter.object.description: Filter by matching an object. Could be a block, item or entity.
text.ledger.parameter.range.description: Filter by location (square radius around your location).
text.ledger.parameter.source.description: Filter by source (player name or source with '@').
text.ledger.network.protocols_mismatched: Protocol versions mismatched: client mod is Ledger protocol version %d and the client version is %d
text.ledger.network.no_mod_info: Unable to determine mod information for your client mod

text.ledger.compact.complete: ------ Compacted %s actions and vacuumed the database ------
text.ledger.help.title: ------ Ledger commands ------
text.ledger.help.hint: Run /ledger help <command> to see one command in detail.
text.ledger.help.params: Filters: action: world: object: range: source: before: after: rolledback:
text.ledger.help.unknown: Unknown command '%s'. Run /ledger help to list them.
text.ledger.help.cmd.inspect.desc: Look up the history of the block you are looking at.
text.ledger.help.cmd.inspect.usage: /ledger inspect | inspect on | inspect off | inspect <x> <y> <z>
text.ledger.help.cmd.search.desc: Search the logs. Opens the results in a paged view.
text.ledger.help.cmd.page.desc: While viewing search results, jump straight to a page.
text.ledger.help.cmd.rollback.desc: Undo every action matching the filters. Worlds are modified.
text.ledger.help.cmd.restore.desc: Put back actions that were previously rolled back.
text.ledger.help.cmd.preview.desc: Show what a rollback or restore would change, without touching the world.
text.ledger.help.cmd.preview.usage: /ledger preview rollback <filters> | preview restore <filters> | preview apply | preview cancel
text.ledger.help.cmd.status.desc: Show Ledger's version, database type and queue state.
text.ledger.help.cmd.tp.desc: Teleport yourself to coordinates and a dimension.
text.ledger.help.cmd.player.desc: Look up when a player first and last joined.
text.ledger.help.cmd.purge.desc: Permanently delete actions matching the filters.
text.ledger.help.cmd.compact.desc: Convert older text rows to the compact form and reclaim disk space.
text.ledger.help.cmd.exportlegacy.desc: Write the stored values back out as plain text, so an unmodified upstream Ledger can read this database.
